institution_name: FDV - Faculdade de Direito de Vitória

coverage.notes: FDV's official undergraduate catalogue identifies one Direito (Law) degree in Vitória, but the directly readable programme pages do not explicitly state the language of delivery for 2027.1. An English-taught 2025 complementary course is not a degree. No bachelor's programme is entered as English-taught without evidence. Search-indexed FDV material dated September 2026 advertises a NEW IB Diploma pathway and open 2027.1 applications; the FDV announcement and current 2027.1 Diploma IB edital were not directly retrievable, and the admissions page opened as a cached 2026.2 version. The qualification-body IB recognition statement was also accessible only as a search result. Consequently, important 2027 details are deliberately held as unresolved leads, not promoted to verified claims. The queried catalogue covers Graduação, with Especialização, Mestrado, Doutorado, Pós-Doutorado and exchanges excluded.

institution.summary: Specialist law college founded in 1995, located in the Santa Lúcia district of Vitória, Espírito Santo, Brazil.

claims.statement: Faculdade de Direito de Vitória (FDV) is a specialist Brazilian higher-education institution founded in September 1995 and based in Vitória, Espírito Santo; its teaching site is in Santa Lúcia.

evidence.locator: História, paragraph beginning "Em 18 de setembro de 1995"
evidence.supports: Dates the founding of FDV and identifies its specialist origin in legal education.

evidence.locator: Footer, address at Rua Juiz Alexandre Martins de Castro Filho, 215
evidence.supports: Identifies the FDV location as Santa Lúcia, Vitória, Espírito Santo.

claims.statement: The institution directs undergraduate applicants to its Graduação FDV admissions website.

evidence.supports: The Law degree page links directly to graduacao.fdv.br for undergraduate entry.
The linked admissions landing page contains an application handoff.

claims.statement: FDV presents one undergraduate Law (Direito) course in its undergraduate section; its specialist postgraduate, master's, doctorate and exchange activities are distinct from first-year undergraduate degrees. The cited catalogue does not establish the teaching language for the 2027 intake.

evidence.locator: Graduação, opening programme description; "Trilhas do Direito"
evidence.supports: States FDV has a single Law degree and its career tracks are complementary activities, not separate degrees.
Separates graduação from pós-graduação, mestrado, doutorado and post-doctorate offerings.

claims.notes: This does not establish that the undergraduate Law programme is English-taught, bilingual or Portuguese-only.

claims.statement: For the 2025.2 term, FDV offered a 14-hour English-language complementary activity called "Current Affairs and the Law"; it was a short course, not a separately admitted bachelor's degree.

applies_to.applicant_group: Students taking complementary activities at FDV

evidence.locator: PDF page 34 (zero-based page 33), "CE - CURRENT AFFAIRS AND THE LAW", especially "APRESENTAÇÃO" and "OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES"
evidence.supports: The course is labelled CE within the complementary-activities guide, described as entirely in English, and has a workload of 14 hours.

claims.notes: The existence of this English-taught short course cannot be used to infer English delivery of the first degree.

claims.statement: The FDV undergraduate landing page available for direct reading listed a VEST entrance test, an ENEM-score route, transfer and second-degree entry. It displayed 2026.2 material rather than an accessible 2027.1 IB edital.

applies_to.applicant_group: Prospective applicants through the listed routes

evidence.locator: Top of landing page, admissions route links; "editais" area
evidence.supports: The accessible snapshot identifies these application channels and links to 2026.2 notices.

claims.notes: The live-search index displays 2027.1 and Diploma IB, but the 2027 page and edital could not be opened for source-level verification.

claims.statement: FDV advertises external student-finance and scholarship channels, including FIES, ProUni and a Sicoob-linked financing option. The displayed references do not confirm their availability, awards or eligibility for a particular 2027 applicant, especially non-Brazilian citizens.

applies_to.applicant_group: Potential undergraduate applicants, subject to each funding scheme's eligibility conditions

evidence.locator: Graduação, "BOLSAS E FINANCIAMENTO" and outgoing links
evidence.supports: Links to financing and scholarship channels including FIES and ProUni.

evidence.locator: Landing page, "bolsas e financiamentos", linked programmes
evidence.supports: Shows several funding or financing channels on the institutional undergraduate admissions page.

claims.notes: These are information links, not a verified award offer for the 2027.1 intake.
